name: Seated scapular retraction
cue: Blades back and down, ribs stay put.

name: Seated passive cervical retraction
cue: Two fingers on the chin, glide straight back.

name: Seated thoracic ext. + pec stretch
cue: Over the chair back, open the chest, breathe out at the top.

name: Sidelying thoracic rotation (open book)
cue: Knees stacked, rotate from the ribs.

name: Bent knee fallouts
cue: Pelvis dead still as the knee drops.

name: Supine march
cue: Low back flat the whole time.

name: Band row
cue: Anchor at chest height. Elbows past the ribs, one-second pause.

name: Band face pull
cue: Pull to the forehead, knuckles back. Lower trap and rear delt.

name: Prone Y raise
cue: Face down, thumbs up, arms at 45°.

name: Bird dog
cue: Hips level, reach long not high.

name: Dead bug
cue: Low back stays flat. Add a band pull overhead when easy.

name: One-arm band hold
cue: Band in one hand, resist the side-bend.

name: Band hip hinge / RDL
cue: Hinge from the hip under tension.
